thread:
maria: heads-up: US-WEST dedicated GPU pool (usw1-dedicated-1) is at sustained 98% util for 12m, queue latency spiking. autoscaler didn't provision extra nodes in time, we're seeing spillover into hosted fallback. looking into root cause now :rotating_light:
ben: can you paste the metrics link? what jobs are the biggest contributors?
maria: dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood/usw1/dedicated-gpu, top culprits are long-chat sessions from prod-chat-route + a batch rerank job suddenly ramped at 13:05 UTC
ash: (cc oncall) oncall:lee please confirm fallback behavior — we should have graceful fallback to hosted, not hard reject customers
lee: confirming: routing policy should fallback to hosted-tier but preserve customer tiering. i'm seeing partial successes but a lot of 503s from the dedicated LB while it flips targets. toggling quick fix: enable immediate fallback flag for route group "prod-chat" via routing service.
maria: doing the toggle now. patching route and increasing dedicated pool overprovision to 20% as temp.
ash: please also throttle non-critical background rerank job, set user-priority header low if possible. cost spike if hosted absorbs all burst.
ash: snippet to throttle rerank_jobs queue (do this in worker config):
```
- name: rerank_job
  concurrency: 4
  priority: low
```
maria: throttled rerank queue, enabled fallback. observing immediate drop in queue latency but hosted CUs increased.
deploy-bot: route-toggle event: prod-chat -> fallback_enabled=true by maria at 1769999999. change-id: rt-2026-0034
ben: what's the expected cost delta if hosted handles the sustained extra 200k tokens/hr? we should estimate before overshoot.
nash: rough calc: +$1.2k/hr at current model (gpt-small-oc) assuming no further batching/caching gains. need finance signoff if >24h.
lee: short term plan: 1) keep fallback enabled, 2) prioritize enterprise customers (marker header) to dedicated if possible, 3) scale dedicated pool by two nodes (manual) and watch for eviction cascades, 4) open ticket for autoscaler tuning
maria: manual scale started (adding 2 x a100-equivalent nodes) — ETA 6m. also rolling out a tiny KV-cache bump to reduce prefix recompute for chat.
ops-bot: alert: usw1-dedicated-1 node-add started by maria at 1769990130, expected ready at 1769990490
ash: we should message affected customers only if we expect degraded SLO >30min. current ETA looks <10m. hold off on broad comms, but prepare a short status note.
nash: action items assigned: ashley to file autoscaler tuning PR, ben to run cost impact calc and post, maria/lee to monitor and scale if needed, oncall to standby.
nash: thx everyone :thumbsup: keeping channel open until stable.
lee: confirmed new nodes healthy, capacity back to 65% after soak. turning down fallback in 2m if metrics hold.
maria: turning fallback off now. us-west traffic should reattach to dedicated.
deploy-bot: route-toggle event: prod-chat -> fallback_enabled=false by maria at 1770000419. change-id: rt-2026-0035
ash: closing thread once we have final postmortem entry in incidents with timeline + autoscaler config change request.
